title: GS21 gvy25 with SIGN-SWITCHING types: the ladder mirrored, six level-exposure types of equal share, gs_bv -0.1, -0.05, -0.015, 0.015, 0.05, 0.1, level-compensated, price 2.5
question: Does a type loading with zero cross-sectional mean, hidden at y = 0 by the level compensation, open room in GS21 the way vyg25s did in KP14 (gvy25: room 2%, gap -0.004)?
notes:
WHY (2026-10-27). The campaign's gaps are small because every economy gives the linear sort a NONZERO correlation with the priced exposure: with one priced factor and N = 500, any such portfolio mimics the factor and diversifies the rest, so it earns the factor's whole Sharpe ratio however curved the exposure is (the 2026-10-26 reduced-form sign screen: room is all or nothing). Room needs the exposure to be orthogonal to every linear function of the characteristics -- in the cross-section (a hidden sign: vyg25s, room 0.35, gap +0.18) or in time (a premium whose sign the constant-weight portfolio cannot follow). gvy25's three positive types are ordered by the same characteristic at every y (the exposed firm is always the cheaper one), so a constant book-to-market sort is always long exposure. With the ladder mirrored, the firm the sort picks at y > 0 has the opposite loading from the one it picks at y < 0, and the constant sort's loading averages to zero. The equity claim multiplies the type by the firm's leverage, which is the product vyg25s has with the growth-option share. The random features condition on y_stand (gs_vy exports it), so the oracle's nonlinear ceiling and DKKM can follow the sign; the linear ceiling and every classical estimator hold constant weights.

FEASIBILITY (gs_solve_vy.py at these overrides, 2026-10-27): gs_ashift derives to -0.580 at gs_bv -0.1 and +0.538 at +0.1 (W(b) is sign-agnostic); the solver starts and sweeps at a negative exposure; gs_sim_vy.py parses negative GS_VY_BV and checks each solution's gs_bv against it.

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-10-27): room 15-30% of the linear ceiling (gvy25 2%); fair gap +0.02 to +0.06, 8+ of 10 seeds positive; the market's share falls from gvy25's 86% toward 40% as the type premia cancel in the index. FALSIFIED as 'a hidden sign opens room in GS21' if room is at or below 5%.

changes: type_share 3 -> 6 equal; gs_bv [0.015, 0.05, 0.1] -> [-0.1, -0.05, -0.015, 0.015, 0.05, 0.1]; six solves sol_gvy25sa..f; gamma_v 2.5, kappa_y 0.35, NY 9, y_mult 2.5, bv_comp 1.2 unchanged

method.gs_vy_sign_ladder: mirrored level-exposure ladder, E[gs_bv] = 0 across types, each type level-compensated at y = 0
